steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Paper 1 of OCR J271 GCSE Law covers The Legal System and Criminal Law — it is worth 80 marks and lasts 1 hour 30 minutes

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Paper 1 Section A focuses on The Legal System: law making, the court system, legal personnel and access to justice

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Paper 1 Section B focuses on Criminal Law: elements of crime, homicide, non-fatal offences, property offences and general defences

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The paper contains a mix of short-answer questions (1-4 marks), medium-answer questions (5-10 marks) and extended-response questions (15 marks)

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Start with the questions you are most confident about — this builds momentum and ensures you gain marks early For Section A, use precise legal terminology — examiners reward accuracy of terms such as 'magistrate', 'lay person', 'statutory interpretation' For Section B criminal scenarios, always work through actus reus then mens rea then defences — this systematic approach prevents you from missing marks In 15-mark questions, write a quick plan with three to four key points before you start — this produces a more coherent answer If a question asks about a specific topic, do not drift into related areas — stay focused on what the question asks
